statements.status_notes: GMS-2017-215 is an unspecified severity advisory for the slug npm package with no fixed version available. The vulnerability affects all versions (>=0.0.0-alpha). Investigation is ongoing to determine if the vulnerable code paths are reachable in the unleash application context and whether alternative mitigations are feasible.
